title: Kusoma kwa Kina (Theme 6: Usawa wa kijinsia)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child chooses an article by topic, level and date, reads it fully, and separates its main point from examples and opinion.

floor.prerequisite: Finds an article on the right shelf.
floor.question: Makala hupatikana wapi?

board.do: Point at the date and title.
Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child chooses one of three articles with the checklist and writes its main point.

misconceptions.repair: Chagua makala kwa mada yake na kiwango cha lugha.
Kwa habari mpya, angalia tarehe ya makala.

misconceptions.ask: Sentensi hii ni wazo kuu au mfano?
misconceptions.repair: Mfano huonyesha wazo kuu; si wazo kuu lenyewe.

listen_for: Shule yetu ina wanafunzi mia tano.
misconceptions.repair: Maoni ni kile mtu anachofikiri; ukweli unaweza kuthibitishwa.

checks.question: Ni kigezo kipi si muhimu: mada, rangi ya jalada, kiwango cha lugha?
"Sayansi ni somo zuri kuliko yote" ni ukweli au maoni?
